text:
alex.gray: hey team :wave: trying to pair my company iPad to my Mac for Sidecar. mac is enrolled in Kandji and FileVault is on, but when I try to prep the iPad with Apple Configurator it errors with 'Activation Lock: Apple ID attached'. iPad shows 'Managed by Redwood Inference' in Settings but refuses to finish enrollment. anyone seen this?

katie-it: did the iPad previously belong to a personal apple id or was it given to you as used? Activation Lock usually means the device is still tied to an Apple ID in ABM/MDM. can you grab the serial from Settings > General > About and DM it to me? do not paste the full Apple ID here.

alex.gray: it was a hand-me-down personal device from my partner, i wiped it with configurator first. serial is F3LQ7X0ZJ1K2 (dm'ing now).

it-bot: kandji: profile apply started for device "alex-mbp-2" (job id: kj-88231).

mdm-admin: thanks @alex.gray. since it was registered to a personal account, ABM likely still has Activation Lock. i've checked our ABM console and this serial is present but currently assigned to a different Apple ID (pre-enrollment). i'll need to release Activation Lock from ABM. can you confirm you have consent from the previous owner to remove their Apple ID? we need that for audit.

alex.gray: yes confirmed, they signed off and reset iCloud. they said they removed the device from their account but maybe it didn't sync.

katie-it: if they removed it from iCloud > Find My, sometimes the device still shows in ABM until inventory sync. i'll trigger a device sync on our side and try to clear the lock. this can take a few minutes.

jamal-devex: fyi Sidecar requires the same Apple ID for continuity features, so even once Activation Lock is cleared, Sidecar will only work if you sign into the iPad with the same (managed) Apple ID as your Mac. our policy is to use Managed Apple IDs for company iPads. do you want us to create a Managed Apple ID for you?

alex.gray: yes please, that'd be great. i didn't know we had managed ids for iPad use.

linda-peopleops: welcome @alex.gray :tada: — we'll provision a Managed Apple ID for you. katie, can you add alex to the device assignment ticket once ABM release is done?

katie-it: on it. triggering ABM sync now. command for the record: in ABM console -> Devices -> choose serial -> Actions -> Release from Activation Lock. if that isn't allowed, we'll raise to Apple Business Support.

mdm-admin: ABM shows the device flagged as "activation_lock_enabled": true. i attempted a release and got a 409 error; submitting a remove request to Apple via ABM support. should be resolved in 24-48 hours unless Apple clears faster. i've attached the support case id: 12345678.

alex.gray: ugh ok, thanks. timeline is fine. can i still use the iPad for basic testing (no managed apps) while we wait, or does Kandji block network?

katie-it: you can use it locally, but don't sign in with your personal Apple ID if you plan to get a Managed Apple ID later. to avoid user-level conflicts, keep it offline or on guest wifi until we finish.

jamal-devex: small workaround if you need Sidecar now: use a second Mac or iPad logged into the same personal Apple ID temporarily, but it's not ideal for security/compliance. better to wait for the managed workflow.

it-bot: support: ABM case 12345678 created (severity: normal).

mdm-admin: update — Apple cleared the lock at 2151236900. i've reassigned the device in ABM to Redwood's org and queued it for automated enrollment in Kandji. you should see the MDM prompt after a factory restore.

alex.gray: awesome! did the managed apple id get created too?

linda-peopleops: yes, alex.gray@redwoodinference.com has been provisioned as a Managed Apple ID. password reset link sent to your personal email (secure).

katie-it: once you factory reset the iPad, follow: 1) connect to wifi 2) you should see "Automatically enrolled by Redwood Inference" on setup 3) accept management -> install profile -> sign in with managed apple id. ping me if the MDM profile fails.

alex.gray: did the factory reset and got the Kandji welcome screen. prompted for managed id and installed profile successfully. Sidecar now wants same apple id on Mac.

jamal-devex: to use Sidecar with managed id, sign out of your personal iCloud on the Mac and sign in with managed apple id under System Settings -> Apple ID. if you prefer not to switch your shell account, we can enable Handoff via company-managed Fast User Account we can create for you.

alex.gray: switched to managed id, Sidecar working. thanks everyone! :raised_hands:

katie-it: marking thread resolved. filing a short onboarding note about used devices to avoid this. tl;dr: always factory reset and confirm removal from personal iCloud before handing device to IT.

linda-peopleops: welcome aboard again, alex :sparkles: let us know if you need any other hardware.

alex.gray: will do, thanks all :)
